name: North East Skill Centre
benefit:
NESC will produce 400 trained candidates annually and offer a **one-year certification** program in - Hospitality - Food & Beverage Service - 100 Nos - Hospitality – Housekeeping - 100 Nos - Retail Service - 100 Nos - Beauty & Wellness - 100 Nos
1. **International Certification**: Graduate with a globally recognized 1-year certificate developed in collaboration with ITE Education
_eligibility_text: 1. **Educational Qualification & Age Limit:** 12th Pass and age between 17 and 25.1. **Domicile Reservation:** 80% seats are reserved for domiciles of Assam. If reserved seats remain vacant, they may be allotted to students from other states.1. **Physical Fitness Requirement:** All the Candidates shall be required to submit a Medical Fitness Certificate from a Registered Medical Practitioner at the time of admission.
